prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A candid, cinematic scene set in a sunlit Japanese street, featuring three teenage boys in school uniforms relaxing outside a small, nostalgic shop. The boys wear white short-sleeved shirts and plaid school trousers; one has a loosened striped tie and glasses, intently focused on his smartphone. The central boy, with slightly tousled hair, sits casually with legs apart, fanning himself with a blue folder and gazing off to the side, his shirt untucked and open at the collar, exuding a sense of summer heat and youthful nonchalance. The third boy, on the right, is cropped slightly out of focus, also absorbed in his phone, contributing to the scene’s natural, documentary feel. The background is filled with retro vending machines, gacha capsule toys, and faded signage, evoking a nostalgic Showa-era atmosphere. The color palette is warm and muted, with soft golden sunlight casting gentle shadows and creating a dreamy, almost filmic quality. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, drawing attention to the boys while softly blurring the background, enhancing the intimate, slice-of-life mood. The overall style is reminiscent of Japanese coming-of-age films, capturing a fleeting, everyday moment of youth and camaraderie.
